US climate-tech underperformance reflects policy uncertainty and high financing costs, but Indonesian names benefit from self-contained regulatory drivers and domestic energy security mandates.
sectors.ai: Buy selective Indonesia renewables names (TOBA, TPIA) on domestic policy momentum and coal-to-clean transition; ignore US weakness as a signal. Trim exposure to US climate-tech laggards (PLUG) given rate sensitivity. Focus on local electrification, biomass, and carbon-credit monetization plays over the next 6-12 months.
